liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Jack Straw one of their favorites [21]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Reviewer says Bobby's distortion made this song unlistenable on this recording, along with West L.A. and Miracle [14]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Reviewer praises Cassidy and the China Cat > Rider as great versions [21]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer singles out China Cat as the high point, and also praises a noodly West L.A. Fadeaway [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-09-07.176415.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 152 min [1]
- **gd1983-09-07.163606.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 151 min [3]
- **gd1983-09-07.143042.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: audience recording; 19 songs; 146 min [5]
- **gd83-09-07.beyer.unk.10254.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 149 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer found Phil loud and crisp, but Bobby's voice and guitar badly distorted, making several songs unlistenable [14]
- **gd1983-09-07.nak300.morris.102052.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 148 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [9]. Said about its sound: Nakamichi 300 recording has more Phil and a balanced sound, avoiding the tinny high end common to Red Rocks tapes [19]
- **gd1983-09-07.nak700.wagner.miller.113550.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 153 min; rated 3.57/5 by 7 [10]. Said about its sound: Best-sounding version so far, but the treble needs taming; reducing it would cloud Garcia's guitar [22]
- **gd1983-09-07.148305.2nd.set.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 10 songs; 88 min [12]

## Around the show

- Red Rocks shows risk rain-outs or delays from thunderstorms; soundboards of Red Rocks shows are hard to find [16]
- Per Phil Lesh's book, he drove across country in a rented car with his future wife, show to show [17]
- Phil had promoted Red Rocks as magical to her and says he dropped bass bombs throughout these shows [17]
- Recalls hearing at the Eugene shows, at the Hult Center, that Phil would drive himself on to Boise [18]
- Reviewer says about 9000 fans attended and danced along [25]
- Tapers deliberately stopped recording before the encore, being careless about the future [5]
- This show is overshadowed by the nights before and after, though the band was tight across all three [21]
- Post-drums setlists are generally more predictable than the rest of a show [23]
- Middle night of the run, judged best show between the Utah and Santa Fe shows; second set is average for 1983 [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-09-07.176415.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [1]. Also: Source cassettes and transfer by Scott Wiseman; coordinated by Charlie Miller; AKG D330T and Sennheiser 421 blend patches Drums > Space and Stella Blue > Sugar Magnolia [1]
- **gd1983-09-07.163606.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Jim Vita's 1st Generation Cassettes [3]. Also: First-generation cassettes from Jim Vita, transferred by Charlie Miller; Bob Wagner's Nakamichi 700 source patches Space and the US Blues encore [3]
- **gd1983-09-07.143042.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew, Kyle Holbrook, Chris Kidwell, Tom Pinney; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: flac24/48 Master: AUD MC Beyer M201's X-Y 5.5'up > Sony TCD5M no dolby Maxell MX90 x 2 Location: 50 feet from stage 8ft ROC [5]. Also: Recorded with Beyer M201 microphones by Holbrook; the encore U.S. Blues is not on this tape [5]
- **gd83-09-07.beyer.unk.10254.sbefail.shnf**: source: 3 Beyer Dynamics M160> Sony TCD5mMater Tape Recorded Half way between Board and Stage [8]
- **gd1983-09-07.nak300.morris.102052.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bob Morris; transferred by Bob Morris; source: Nakamichi CM-300 (CP-1) x2 > Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/Maxell UDXLII C-90) [9]
- **gd1983-09-07.nak700.wagner.miller.113550.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) 3 Nakamichi 700 Omni's -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S90) [10]
- **gd1983-09-07.148305.2nd.set.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG D330BT mics + (1) Sennheiser 421 > Fostex Mixer > Sony D5M [12]
